newsitem.title: RUSSIA: St Pete Promstroibank buys Russia Lensvyaz stake.
newsitem.headline: St Pete Promstroibank buys Russia Lensvyaz stake.

text.p: A unit of St Petersburg's Promstroibank bought a two percent stake in Russian regional telecom Lensvyaz at an auction on Thursday, a spokesman for the company said on Friday.
Baltiiskoye Finansovoye Agenstvo investment company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Promstroibank, Baltiiskoe spokeswoman Irina Sharipova told Reuters.

The Leningrad regional property fund, in charge of the northwest region around St Petersburg, had not announced the identity of the winner of the auction of 53,038 ordinary shares of AO Lensvyaz, acquired for 20.92 billion roubles ($3.6 million).
Lensvyaz chief economist Galina Shabanova said conditions were being prepared for an investment tender for a 20 percent company stake still in property fund hands. $=5,786 roubles
